第732章 纠结的长老（第1页）
一旦少年陨落，他孤身回归魔土，迎接他的必然是最残酷的酷刑与无尽责罚，修为尽废、魂飞魄散皆是常态。
更甚者，他的家族、麾下附属势力，都会因护主不力遭到牵连清算。
一边是一己生死、家族荣辱、魔君雷霆之怒；一边是全城魔族修士的性命、数万族人的存续、数日磨合换来的多种族守城大局。
城上年轻魔族修士的请战声愈发急切，不少人攥紧兵刃，眼底满是焦灼，频频望向城外漆黑的虚空，只盼长老一声令下，即刻冲城营救少主。
而一众老成修士则死死按住同伴，低声劝阻，字字泣血，句句点明大局为重，两军对峙般的拉扯，让西门军心彻底浮动。
其余三门的各族修士皆屏息凝神，无心再战，余光始终锁死西门动向。
妖族首领收了随意戒备的姿态，周身妖力暗自蓄力，随时准备填补西门可能出现的防线空缺。
秦晏之眉头深锁，抬手稳住周边人族阵型，已然做好了随时驰援、兜底堵漏的准备。
草木长老带着一众灵体精怪缩在墙体边角，草木本源剧烈震颤，满心惶恐，深知这场抉择的结果，直接决定整片孤城的存亡。
隐于暗处的林鹤清，也静静注视着那道苍老挺拔又无比孤寂的背影。
他能清晰感知到长老内心的撕裂与煎熬，更能察觉到虚空深处，异兽首领的气息愈发蛰伏沉稳，耐心等待着对方一念之差的崩盘。只要长老心绪失守、贸然分兵，这场守城之战，便会瞬间倾覆。
秦晏之见状不再等候，当即迈步穿过交战的人流，来到西门城头。
他神色恳切，语气并无半分逼迫，只有据实相劝：“长老，你心中苦楚众人都看在眼里。可孤城试炼规则摆在眼前，城门一旦失守，驻守在此的所有人都会判定失败。
若是你抽调兵力出城救援，防线出现缺口，不止魔族修士会葬身兽潮，人族、妖族、草木灵体无一能够幸免。
一人之存亡，不该搭上在场万族天骄所有人的试炼机缘。”
北门妖族首领也借着两族衔接的通道赶至一旁，粗重的声音带着几分直白：“我知晓那名少年是魔族重点培养的后辈，失去他于魔族而言损失巨大。
但眼下兽潮攻势凶猛，暗处还有异兽首领伺机而动。

一旦西门兵力空虚，兽潮冲破城墙，我们所有人都要困死在此地。
倘若城破，就算你拼死救出少主，失去试炼资格，到头来依旧是一场空。”
草木长老亦带着数名精怪上前，草木之声轻柔，却格外清醒：“灵体一族肉身孱弱，根本承受不住异兽洪流。
防线若是崩溃，我们会最先被异兽吞噬。
长老，盟约之下各族性命相连，还望你以全局为重。”
周遭不少人族与妖族巡查修士纷纷附和，轮番出言劝说。
所有人并非冷血漠视少年的性命，只是历经重重凶险才搭建起联防阵线，没有人愿意数日的坚守毁于一次冲动的抉择。

Chapter 732 The Tangled Elder (Page 1)
Once the young man dies and returns to the demonic land alone, he will be greeted by the most cruel torture and endless punishment. It is normal for his cultivation to be completely destroyed and his soul to be scattered.
What's more, his family and affiliated forces will be implicated and liquidated due to his failure to protect the Lord.
On one side is one's own life and death, the honor and disgrace of the family, and the thunderous wrath of the Demon King; on the other side is the life of the demon monks in the city, the survival of tens of thousands of tribesmen, and the overall situation of the multi-racial defense of the city that has been achieved through several days of hard work.
The calls for battle from the young demon monks on the city became more and more urgent. Many of them clenched their weapons tightly, their eyes full of anxiety, and they frequently looked into the dark void outside the city, hoping that the elder would give the order and rush to the city to rescue the young master immediately.
However, a group of mature monks held down their companions tightly, whispered to dissuade them, cried out every word, and pointed out that the overall situation was the most important. The two armies were pulling against each other, which made the Ximen Army's morale completely fluctuate.
The monks of all races in the other three gates held their breaths and concentrated, with no intention of fighting anymore, and their peripheral vision always locked onto the movement of the west gate.
The leader of the demon tribe lowered his casual alert posture, and secretly accumulated the demonic power around him, ready to fill any gaps in the defense line that might arise at the west gate.
Qin Yanzhi frowned deeply, raised his hand to stabilize the surrounding human formations, and was ready to rush to help at any time and plug the leaks.
The elders of the grass and trees huddled in the corner of the wall with a group of spirits and monsters. The roots of the grass and trees were shaking violently, and they were filled with fear. They knew that the outcome of this decision would directly determine the survival of the entire isolated city.
Lin Heqing, who was hiding in the dark, also quietly stared at the old, tall, and extremely lonely back.
He could clearly feel the tearing and torment in the elder's heart, and he could also sense that deep in the void, the aura of the leader of the alien beasts became increasingly dormant and steady, patiently waiting for the other party's collapse at the slightest thought. As long as the elder loses his mind and divides his troops rashly, the battle to defend the city will be overturned in an instant.
When Qin Yanzhi saw this, he no longer waited, and immediately walked through the crowd of fighting people and came to the head of Ximen City.
His expression was sincere, and his tone was not at all coercive. He only advised based on the truth: "Elder, everyone can see the pain in your heart. But the rules of the trial in the isolated city are in front of you. Once the city gate is lost, everyone stationed here will be judged to have failed.
If you send troops out of the city for rescue and there is a gap in the defense line, not only the demon monks will be killed by the beast tide, but also the humans, demons, and vegetation spirits will be spared.
One person's life or death should not depend on the trial opportunities of all the geniuses of all races present. "
The leader of the Beimen Demon Clan also rushed to the side through the passage connecting the two clans, and his thick voice was somewhat straightforward: "I know that young man is a young man whom the Demon Clan focuses on training. Losing him is a huge loss to the Demon Clan.
But now the beast tide is fierce, and there are alien beast leaders waiting for an opportunity in the dark.
Once Ximen's troops are empty and the beast tide breaks through the city wall, we will all be trapped here and die.
If the city is destroyed, even if you risk your life to save the young master and lose the qualification for the trial, it will still be in vain in the end. "
Elder Cao Mu also came forward with several spirits and monsters. Cao Mu's voice was soft but extremely sober: "The spirit clan has a weak body and cannot withstand the torrent of alien beasts.
If the defense line collapses, we will be the first to be devoured by strange beasts.
Elder, the lives of all races are connected under the covenant, and I hope you will put the overall situation first. "
Many of the patrolling monks from the human race and demon race around him agreed and took turns giving words of persuasion.
Everyone was not cold-bloodedly indifferent to the young man's life, but had only gone through many dangers to set up a joint defense front. No one was willing to ruin their persistence for several days by an impulsive decision.
